events.title: RPG MAKER U2U P2D Map Editor Demo Now Available for a Limited Time!
events.summary: The P2D Map Editor Demo is now available on Steam! Try your hand at map creation in RPG Maker U2U!P2D (Perspective 2D) is a new map style in RPG Maker U2U. P2D maps are created with height and depth using intuitive controls.With this demo, users can try creating their own P2D maps, explore a variety of visual effects, and preview walking animations.
